notes.title: Getting ready for Full Release
notes.notes:
Following a period of beta testing and using feedback to improve/fix FragmentVR, I think it is time to transition from Early Access to Full Release. There are still a lot of features I want to put in like Vive Pro and external camera support, smoother views and even better performance, but FragmentVR is stable and complete enough to loose the Early Access tag by now. The transition should happen before the end of January.

If anyone still has any problems or suggestions please let me know in the discussions or on the Discord server and I'll be sure to address them before going through with Full Release.

Thanks for the support so far, especially the volunteers that took the time to give me feedback and error logs, I really appreciate it.

notes.title: Dashboard Menu Redesign and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The menu has a new look now:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33356023/6f0ba1dd5105b3914ee4b58a7f7f1309fbf155c9.png

The save and load features have now become the default behavior and as such aren't on the menu anymore, views will be automatically saved on close and loaded on open.

Some issues with Nvidia cards that have been reported recently should now be fixed.

notes.title: Prerelease Patch!
notes.notes:
Some quality of life features have been added in right in time for release:

-Hide & Lock Corners toggle: Enabling this hides the corner logos and makes them unmovable
-Opacity Slider: Opacity can now be manually set
